title: 第13章 骨骼惊奇的少年哟第14章 我是你二大爷
slug: 掌门师伯新收了个女徒弟
content_zh:
此刻的周清全身打着摆子，面色通红，脖颈处更是青筋狰狞。
听着后面急速接近的窸窸窣窣声，他内心咆哮，而后奋力一跃，直接跳出了最后的重力区。
顿时，全身一阵轻松，整个人就此软绵绵的趴在了地上。
可顾不得休息，赶紧连滚带爬的躲到不远处的柱子后，刚闪进去，那些游魂就呼啸着从通道返回。
直至彻底消失后，周清才长舒一口气，心有余悸地苦笑。
“果然，人的潜力还是被逼出来的，这么长的路，我竟然用这么短的时间就通过了！”
话刚说到此处，无数游魂再度嘶吼着冲了出来，此番的数量竟然比之前还要多。
看的周清一阵头皮发麻。
“难道是太上长老他们派人来救我了？”周清眼睛一亮。
稍微恢复了些许体力后，周清看着前方静悄悄的通道，立马四顾寻找起来。
“这里还是太危险了，不能就此坐以待毙，得尽快找到那钥匙，一旦解除了重力，太上长老们就能进来了，到时才算真正的安全！”
想清楚后，周清开始蹑手蹑脚的找寻起来，更是不敢发出一点声响，万一此地还有金丹境的游魂，他那可就真的交代在这里了。
可逛了一圈，什么也没发现。
“不应该啊，太上长老不是说，钥匙就在重力区边缘地带吗？”
周清疑惑，又找了一圈后，他不由一阵骂骂咧咧，随后看向更深处。
“周清啊周清，你也太单纯了，这群老女人还说重力区安全呢，结果怎么样，跟撵狗似的，她们的话能信？”
周清目光看向深处，又有些犹豫，太上长老特意叮嘱过，进来后绝对不准深入乱闯，只需打开钥匙在原地静等她们便是。
短暂思索后，周清心中有了决断：“她们的话我看得反着来，没有就是有，不让进其实就是进。”
想清楚后，他从储物袋取出一枚月光珠，便开始了前进。
只是刚走几步，他似乎发现了什么，顿时加快脚步。

此刻在一侧的墙壁上，竟然出现了一个半米左右的盗洞，地上更是丢弃着大量的青砖。
周清有些不可思议，因为勾成这面墙壁的青砖并非是普通的砖头，而是以一种奇特的寒玉所铸，甚至彼此牵引，蕴含神秘阵法。
连着太上长老她们都进不了，只能派遣他们进来从内部打开门户的。
可如今竟被他人悄无声息给破坏了。
随着月光珠照耀而去，旁边竟然还嚣张的刻下两个得意洋洋的字——就这？
“就这？”
周清喃喃，似乎看到了对方那得意的样子，不由感到一阵憋屈。
堂堂太清门最为神秘的洞天之地，竟然被这等宵小之辈给挑衅。
太上长老和掌教师叔他们要是见到这一幕，岂不是要被气死？
周清脑袋伸进去，里面漆黑一片，也不知道通向哪里？
他可不敢借此出去，毕竟来此洞天时，太上长老都不让他们知晓其路线呢。
随着周清起身继续前行，很快就看到了那磨盘之物。
顿时一脸惊喜，连忙跑过去。
“这是被人丢在这里的？”
周清并没有先着急转动，而是左右观察了一下，地上有深深的划痕，看样子是被拖拽此处。
“难道是那贼人？”周清又回头看了看石壁上的大洞，轻声自语。
好在如今找到钥匙，还是赶紧让太上长老进来吧，万一再遇到什么危险，我可扛不住。
四周安静一片，鬼气森森，连着空气都散发着一股霉味。
他赶紧跳到磨盘上，运转体内灵力，就要逆

content_en:
At this moment, Zhou Qing's whole body was shaking, his face was red, and the veins on his neck were hideous.
Hearing the rustling sound approaching rapidly from behind, he roared in his heart, and then jumped out of the final gravity zone with all his strength.
Suddenly, his whole body felt relaxed, and he lay limply on the ground.
But he didn't care about resting, and quickly rolled and crawled to hide behind a pillar not far away. As soon as he ducked in, the wandering souls roared back from the passage.
It wasn't until he completely disappeared that Zhou Qing breathed a sigh of relief and smiled bitterly with lingering fear.
"Sure enough, people's potential is still forced to come out. I passed such a long road in such a short time!"
As soon as he said this, countless wandering souls roared out again, and this time the number was even greater than before.
Zhou Qing's scalp felt numb when he saw it.
"Could it be that the Supreme Elder and others sent someone to rescue me?" Zhou Qing's eyes lit up.
After recovering a little strength, Zhou Qing looked at the quiet passage ahead and immediately started looking around.
"It's still too dangerous here. We can't just sit back and wait for death. We have to find the key as soon as possible. Once the gravity is lifted, the elders can come in. Only then will it be truly safe!"
After thinking clearly, Zhou Qing began to look for it quietly, not daring to make a sound. If there was a wandering soul in the Golden Core Realm here, he would really tell him that it was here.
But after walking around, I found nothing.
"It shouldn't be. Didn't the Supreme Elder say that the key is on the edge of the gravity zone?"
Zhou Qing was confused. After searching around again, he couldn't help cursing, and then looked deeper.
"Zhou Qing, Zhou Qing, you are too naive. These old women even said that the gravity zone is safe. What happened? It's like chasing a dog away. Can you believe what they say?"
Zhou Qing looked deeper and hesitated. The Supreme Elder had specifically told them that they were not allowed to go in deeply after entering. All they had to do was open the key and wait for them.
After thinking for a short time, Zhou Qing made a decision in his heart: "I see the opposite of what they said. If you don't have it, you have it. If you don't let them in, you will actually let them in."
After thinking clearly, he took out a moonlight bead from his storage bag and started moving forward.
After just a few steps, he seemed to have discovered something and immediately quickened his pace.
At this moment, a hole of about half a meter appeared on the wall on one side, and a large number of green bricks were discarded on the ground.
Zhou Qing was a little unbelievable, because the green bricks that made up this wall were not ordinary bricks, but made of a strange cold jade. They even pulled each other and contained mysterious formations.
Even the Supreme Elders and the others couldn't enter, so they could only be sent in to open the door from the inside.
But now it was quietly destroyed by others.
As the moonlight beads shone away, two words of triumph were arrogantly carved next to it - that's it?
"That's it?"
Zhou Qing murmured, as if seeing the other party's proud look, he couldn't help but feel aggrieved.
The most mysterious cave in the Taiqing Sect was actually provoked by such a young person.
If the Supreme Elder and the Head Teacher Uncle saw this scene, wouldn't they be angry to death?
Zhou Qing stuck his head in. It was pitch black inside, and he didn't know where it led to?
He didn't dare to use this to go out. After all, when he came to this cave, the Supreme Elder didn't let them know his route.
As Zhou Qing stood up and continued to move forward, he soon saw the millstone.
Suddenly he looked surprised and ran over quickly.
"Did someone leave this here?"
Zhou Qing did not turn around anxiously first, but looked around. There were deep scratches on the ground, and it looked like he had been dragged here.
"Is it the thief?" Zhou Qing looked back at the big hole in the stone wall and whispered to himself.
Fortunately, now that I have found the key, I'd better let the Supreme Elder in quickly. If I encounter any danger again, I won't be able to bear it.
It's quiet and ghostly all around, even the air exudes a musty smell.
He quickly jumped onto the millstone and circulated his spiritual power to reverse the situation.
